verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a data-center GPU, a hardware accelerator with no end-user application surface where a user's data is analyzed and AI insights are shown, so this story is a category error for the product type. Bundled software such as NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM microservices and cuML are developer building blocks for constructing such applications, not an in-product insights feature, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
